selectedArchitecture.invariant: Invariant B: A run may have multiple immutable evidence snapshots, but at most one authoritative terminal record.

identityDecoupling.immutableContentIdentity: bundleId = SHA-256(canonical JSON of bundle content)

selectedArchitecture.orderingInvariant: storeAccepted writes immutable content-addressed bundle FIRST; establishAuthoritativeTerminal writes authoritative terminal pointer SECOND. Crash recovery heals missing terminal records idempotently.

implementationBoundary.adapter: FileSystemEvidenceArchive (atomic writes via tempfile + renameSync, archive/runs/<runId>/terminal.json)
implementationBoundary.gateway: EvidenceIngestionGateway (Step 7 Terminal Authority Index Fencing, Step 10 healing on duplicate re-ingestion, Step 11 terminal record establishment)

threatMitigation.f22LogicalIdentityGap: RESOLVED — Conflicting terminal bundles with differing bundleId for the same runId can no longer enter accepted archive.
threatMitigation.forgeryRejection: Even valid 2-of-3 threshold quorum signatures cannot overwrite an established terminal record.
threatMitigation.availabilitySafetyTradeoff: Non-terminal intermediate snapshots remain fully ingestible for debugging/audit without violating terminal uniqueness.
